entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an official Hermes Agent provider through a managed cloud, self-hosted server, or an Apache-2.0 open-source SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes agent context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to reduce token consumption. This AGPL-3.0 context database offers observable retrieval trajectories and demonstrated a 91% token reduction in LoCoMo10 testing.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain utilizes a self-wiring knowledge graph with typed entity relationships to manage information. It features gap analysis to identify missing data in queries and supports multi-tenant deployments with scoped access for company environments.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine features a custom vector graph engine and automated fact extraction to maintain user profiles across 100B+ tokens per month. It supports hybrid RAG search and byte-level deduplication with connectors for Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight implements long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows to help agents learn from past interactions. It integrates with over 25 LLM providers and is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or Python and Node.js clients.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a FastAPI-based library that enables reasoning-first memory by extracting conclusions from conversation history. It serves as the upstream library for Hermes-specific wrappers and supports managed, local, or Docker Compose deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This Elastic License 2.0 provider treats memory as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging for markdown context trees. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system to achieve sub-100ms recall and includes an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database for local data storage. It provides sub-millisecond performance and supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for integration with tools like Cursor and Claude Code.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context over other data. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to provide structured facts and auto-curated wikis.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts such as traces and context bundles. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to validate the effectiveness of context changes.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin uses a Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) and SQLite to provide lossless context management for Hermes Agents. It includes specialized tools for searching and expanding compacted material to ensure no messages are lost during hierarchical summarization.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This project provides a self-hosted backend for Honcho to enable private, cross-session memory for Hermes Agents. It includes automated setup scripts for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis, supporting any OpenAI-compatible or local inference provider.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI provides a local-first identity and memory layer that enables portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy and supports data imports from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur is a shared memory layer that stores human-readable YAML engrams on local disks for multi-agent systems. It utilizes a hybrid search combining BM25 and local embeddings for retrieval via the Model Context Protocol.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It integrates with Hermes Agent through MCP and plugins, utilizing hybrid retrieval that includes vector search and BM25.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes context through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse in Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and can save up to 36% of tokens during inference.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It features a five-package plugin family, including a dedicated Hermes adapter and MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recall with a 'why_retrieved' explanation. It includes a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets per query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd features an anticipatory cache that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn provides cross-project memory for coding agents by using an Obsidian vault as the primary source of truth. It stores memory as inspectable Markdown files and uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It supports MCP-native integration and uses SQLite with FTS5 for local-first memory persistence.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep is a reflective memory system that uses BM25 full-text search and ranked graph traversal to navigate stored notes. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard for tracking estimated token savings.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes an embedded .lbdb graph database to surface high-priority information through importance-weighted recall. It features BM25 keyword search and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction to manage named graph relationships between entries.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This Git-backed layer manages identity and project state for coding agents using plain Markdown files and hash-checked proposals. It provides dedicated adapters for Hermes and other frameworks to facilitate session handoffs and decision logging.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: Designed as a pull-model episodic memory plugin, this tool supports immediate event deletion and on-demand summarization to prevent persistent data from affecting future recall. It includes a trace.jsonl audit log to provide a transparent record of every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables Hermes agents to handle payments across 29 chains and 10 families, including EVM and Solana. It allows agents to pay for services or charge for APIs with direct wallet settlement and zero transaction fees.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable cross-session memory through semantic search, pre-turn context injection, and session-end snapshots. It ensures reliability via a local SQLite layer and a write outbox for managing state updates.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes and routes queries to local skills, runbooks, and MCP servers using five specialized tools for artifact retrieval. It features an opt-in worker that automatically generates tool-OKF notes to enhance local capability management.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports manual memory storage and advanced retrieval techniques, including configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports multiple retrieval methods including HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index search. It can be deployed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, enabling semantic search and grounded Q&A through a local SourceVault server. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for indexing and reading files.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This suite includes 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid search of BM25, vector, and graph methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing to preserve information during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based toolkit focuses on memory hygiene by using 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify stale or conflicting data in a git-backed directory. It operates without a database, instead providing slash commands to capture and propose evidence-cited diffs for manual review.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development methodology to execute engineering tasks autonomously. It enforces a structured workflow of brainstorming, planning, and TDD while integrating as a plugin for various coding agents and CLI tools.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design and prototyping system that supports 26 CLI executables, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It features a sandboxed iframe for live iterations and exports artifacts to formats such as HTML, PDF, and MP4.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and NIST AI RMF. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms to enhance agent security capabilities.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee serves as a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill enables agents to generate editable .drawio files from natural language descriptions using 11 diagram type presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities and can convert Mermaid text into diagram formats.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Acting as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill facilitates natural-language mandates, delegated permissions, and x402 payments. It includes a master router and connector skills alongside a verification and dispute resolution layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using a two-pass detection system. It supports Rewrite, Detect, and Edit-in-place modes with optional voice profiles for different professional tones.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: SkillClaw enables collective skill evolution by supporting skill merging and cross-pollination across agents like Hermes and QwenPaw. It provides a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and managing evolving skill sets.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library featuring 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with Claude Code and Codex. It maintains session state within the project's documentation directory to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection contains 1,153 markdown-based skills for professional and life tasks that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It includes specific integrations for platforms such as Slack, Telegram, Obsidian, and n8n.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set allows agents to perform video searches, extract transcripts, and browse channels or playlists on YouTube. It is compatible with Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, and Cursor, requiring a TranscriptAPI key for operation.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects reusable patterns in active workflows to propose new skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage these skills via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses across various domains and reports findings alongside a dedicated analysis of potential blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This toolkit provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts for Pydantic AI. It implements progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports both remote registries and programmatic skills.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill automates the transition from rough concepts to structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes to accommodate different project complexities and includes a spec review gate with PASS/FAIL evaluation models.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits from those files back into the primary literate document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro acts as a harness for long-running agents using a mechanism kernel that operates without a background service. It organizes workflows through four distinct roles—Human, Supervisor, Lead, and Peer—and requires Herdr for hosting Supervisor rooms.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory by capturing high-value decisions and outcomes in markdown files. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning models and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills enable Hermes Agent to interact with oracle networks and smart contracts via CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. The project follows the Agent Skills specification and includes specialized modules for CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This repository serves the Brazilian community by providing Hermes Agent skills, installation guides, and configuration resources in Portuguese. All skills are provided in the SKILL.md format and adhere to the agentskills.io standard.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills integrate FLUX.2 image and FLUX 3 video generation models into agent workflows. The project includes specialized modules for prompt optimization, audio directing, and specific visual formats like cinematic inserts and product ads.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discussions into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It ensures precision by linking instructions to specific file lines at pinned commits and generates audit trails for provenance.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: Skilldock.io functions as a registry for reusable AI skills, offering a Python client and CLI for installation. It manages complex environments through recursive dependency resolution and supports commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill manages complex, multi-step tasks by providing autonomous execution with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery from execution errors.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika introduces an 'Intent as Code' workflow language that audits permissions, costs, and types before executing locally via a single Rust binary. It ensures accountability by generating hash-chained, tamper-evident receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes to manage files, notes, calendars, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It features a guided setup script for secure HTTPS communication using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during tool discovery. It employs a socket-based daemon to maintain persistent connections and incrementally fetch server metadata.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye provides a five-layer retrieval system that combines hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. The system is designed for resilience, offering graceful degradation if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: HermesHub serves as a community platform for browsing and installing skills, fully implementing the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and integrates federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is a personal execution system where an agent manages system design while the user completes tasks via a tap-based interface. It stores all data locally in SQLite and connects to AI agents through the Model Context Protocol.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only code review skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial, edge-case, and integration analysis. It combines deterministic pre-scans with proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox to verify findings.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across multiple surfaces like CLI and Discord, scoring them across five quality dimensions. It supports 97 languages and claims to reduce token usage by 20–80% per rewrite.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: Fablize adapts verified procedures for task decomposition, requiring evidence-based gating and systematic investigation protocols. It includes a Python goal engine to maintain persistent state during complex causal debugging.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses a swarm of Hygiene, Clarity, and Correctness agents to simplify code in five major programming languages. It features a tiered application process that includes a mandatory approval gate for changes.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure through SKILL.md files and automatically registers common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab provides Hermes with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, covering CVE-driven scenarios ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: This project provides production-tested session management to maintain memory between agent conversations and orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews. It includes specialized tools for worktree recovery, state drift detection, and skill scaffolding.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible recording scripts using vhs or Playwright to generate demo GIFs for repository READMEs. It ensures all generated files are optimized under 8 MB and embeds them directly into the documentation.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates portable agent skills from plain language while monitoring official frontmatter specs to prevent bit rot. It includes a validator with CI-friendly exit codes to ensure skills remain compliant with runtime-specific profiles.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This host-agnostic framework creates a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It gates all updates behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluators and operates locally using the Python standard library.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with compatible clients like Hermes and Cursor.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This project enables deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax without requiring new software installations.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first observability dashboard provides 11 monitoring tabs for tracking token costs, errors, and session health in real-time. It enforces a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports optional incident alerts via Telegram or Feishu.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as Pay Link, x402, and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the agentskills.io standard and the Hermes Agent.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This utility certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It produces cryptographically verifiable certificates using Ed25519 signatures to confirm a skill actually works.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by answering support bounties without requiring an account or API key. It includes tools for listing bounties and creating boards, with payments settled after human approval.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global to street-level perspectives. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to produce structured reports with actionable suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides tools for video-to-text conversion, OCR, and agent memory management across macOS, Linux, and Windows. It adheres to the agentskills.io and Hermes Agent standards for cross-platform compatibility.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project enables Hermes Agent to access structured web data across 31 platforms by exposing 191 tools through a hosted MCP server. It includes five production-grade workflow skills and supports integration with environments such as Claude, Cursor, Goose, and OpenHands.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, that are automatically updated on a daily basis. It integrates tools from various providers like Google and OpenAI into a reproducible development environment.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers automated installers and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script for deploying Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. The setup supports over 70 tools, persistent memory, and compatibility with both local Ollama models and cloud API providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments with a focus on single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows, including a configurable gateway mode with API and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS using Termux and iSH. It extends agent functionality with Telegram integration for voice and file messaging, alongside support for scheduled tasks via cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a simple Docker sandbox image that bundles official Hermes installations with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to build specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane designed to deploy and operate Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It includes a REST API and CLI for managing per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and CLI settings. It features a hybrid skill management system and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane for managing multiple agent instances with RBAC-controlled access and separate workspaces. It supports hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and enterprise MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project enables headless, reboot-safe deployments on Ubuntu and Debian servers using systemd. It configures the Hermes Gateway for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated offline environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework coordinates specialized agents for fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysis to manage financial portfolios. It utilizes a structured workflow ranging from research debates to portfolio management across multiple LLM providers.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, and cost tracking through a Web UI or CLI. It supports multi-agent workflows with integrated memory browsing and can be deployed locally via Node.js or Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages persistent coding agent sessions, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for background execution and Docker for sandboxing. It is designed for multi-repo workspace management and supports Git worktrees across TUI and web interfaces.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template serves as an MCP agent execution engine on the Solana blockchain, managing everything from single VPS agents to specialist teams. It implements the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode and features HTTP signal detection for handling paid API states.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Utilizing a level-based architecture, this project scales Hermes Agent from individual units to automated teams via a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for specific infrastructure tasks such as VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the creation of autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It differentiates its orchestration through visual org charts that map agent team delegations.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live reasoning streams. It emphasizes human-in-the-loop verification by requiring manual review for all agent-proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates a strict pipeline of 17 specialized agents focused on research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. A Master Orchestrator manages the routing and coordination across the entire multi-agent stack.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via a Hermes Kanban interface.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. It uses Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualizing the competition through a real-time dashboard and scoreboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080 and 5080. It utilizes Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for coding agents. It automatically synchronizes its index upon file changes and supports languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool and visualization dashboard designed to track token usage and costs across multiple AI coding agents. It allows developers to monitor expenses and submit data to a leaderboard or public profile.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from various coding agents while redacting authentication headers for security. It generates self-contained HTML viewers for exported sessions, facilitating the debugging of agent communications.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to help developers build better user interfaces with AI. It integrates with any provider supporting markdown and is compatible with agents like Hermes, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time monitoring of tokens, costs, and account rate limits directly from agent states. It supports multi-device synchronization to keep usage data consistent across different machines.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project acts as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills for application development. It supports autonomous execution on both laptops and VPS environments.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows for the customization of the terminal UI through YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. Users can modify visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills natively into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and RL training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable identity handles. It facilitates agent-to-agent commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser built for autonomous agent control via MCP, featuring a supervisor sidebar for workflow management. It supports multiple AI providers and includes an undo functionality for reversing recent agent changes.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory capabilities for various frameworks and includes a plugin for automatic context recall. It also offers chat bot integrations for platforms such as Telegram, Slack, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent workflows. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for finance, devops, and research, featuring automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to seamlessly switch between default and scoped agents while managing specific skills and custom instructions at the directory level.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides a zero-cost setup that includes support for 29 community plugins categorized into six functional areas.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed to validate AI agent configurations and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It performs local, deterministic checks to identify overlapping tool descriptions and inconsistent schemas, supporting integration via GitHub Actions and pre-commit hooks.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw environments to Hermes Agent by converting SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It handles the setup of systemd gateway services and maps nested authentication structures to the Hermes architecture.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability platform provides passive monitoring and active probing for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes configuration-aware baselines by monitoring local files.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, open-mic capabilities to Hermes Agent with support for 35 languages and wake-word activation. It features adaptive turn-taking and barge-in functionality while requiring no API keys or external accounts.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This local-first skill uses dynamic slash commands to help users generate revenue through Hermes Agent. It operates within a deterministic local runtime and utilizes a bounded JSON adapter, requiring explicit approval for all external actions or writes.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: A memory plugin for Hermes that enables semantic search and automatic conversation persistence via the MemOS API. It provides dedicated tools for managing memories and includes a circuit breaker to handle potential API outages.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built on the Tauri 2 framework, supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It serves as an all-in-one tool for managing configurations for Hermes Agent alongside other command-line interfaces like Claude Code and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that integrates built-in and external agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It features 21 professional assistants for document creation and enables remote access through a WebUI or messaging platforms like Telegram.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This Python and vanilla JavaScript interface provides a way to interact with Hermes Agent via web browsers or mobile devices. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure access through SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the deployment of Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It provides a graphical interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard offers a visual workflow canvas with node-based orchestration and approval gates for Hermes Agent. It supports unified configuration across 10 platforms, including Discord and WhatsApp, while providing usage analytics and multi-profile model discovery.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for agent orchestration. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and a dedicated memory browser and skills manager.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other agents into a desktop, server, or Docker-based environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and provides native mobile clients for iOS and Android.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access and native views for managing sessions, Kanban boards, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports MCP tools, memory management, and rendering for LaTeX and Mermaid diagrams.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects a local or remote Hermes Agent runtime directly to the active browser context. It features live browser control with explicit approval gates and site-aware drafting capabilities for various writing environments.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone application that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes Agent from iOS 18+ devices. It pairs with a hermes-webui server via HTTPS or Tailscale to enable real-time chat, task management, and file browsing.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, as well as a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI consciousness monitor features nine tabs and four color themes for tracking agent growth and git projects. It provides a specialized tmux operator view for managing live agent panes and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard offers a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and an MCP server control plane for managing server lifecycles. It includes the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines alongside real-time chat and tool call visualization.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks live quota burn by model, tokens, or cost across 15 agent sources. It operates locally without telemetry, providing searchable transcripts and image browsing for coding-agent CLIs.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and React 19, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a dedicated approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Constructed with OpenTUI, this alternative dashboard provides a text-based interface for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management and supports the configuration of profiles, skills, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI for Telegram supports background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This Windows desktop application requires no installation or admin rights and supports both cloud and local AI models via LM Studio. It includes a dynamic tool maker for creating API and Python handlers alongside built-in ComfyUI and TTS support.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a file browser for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers paired with a task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Focused on process monitoring, this dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, plus read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This self-hosted workspace features a chat-first design with tool approval cards and real-time SSE streaming. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management for separate memory and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents through a central PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 one-click installations and a native interface for streaming chat responses.
